verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents some first-party controls over the user's mail. Unwanted physical mail is shredded on-site, with destruction certificates available on request (docs-43). Users can also ask that mail not be opened or scanned at all, so no digital copy is created (docs-9). Otherwise the evidence only describes 'unlimited cloud storage' of scanned PDFs (docs-34, docs-40), with no user-facing retention controls. Missing for 10: user deletion of scanned digital copies, configurable retention periods, account data deletion/export policy, API-based deletion, and independent corroboration.
